text: At its meeting on June 8, 2021, City Council adopted Item PH23.9, and directed the Housing Secretariat to identify a non-profit development partner to design, build, finance and operate a new mixed-use affordable rental housing development including cultural space, a new park and a portion of a public lane at 15 Denison Avenue for 99 years under a long-term lease with the City. City Council also authorized the Executive Director, Housing Secretariat to allocate up to $200,000.00 in funding from the Capital Revolving Reserve Fund for Affordable Housing (XR1058) for the purpose of completing pre-development activities and due diligence work to help advance the development.
